description: Sync prospects, prospect accounts and opportunities from one Pardot business unit, one document per record.
opening: Sync prospects, prospect accounts and opportunities from one Pardot business unit. Each prospect is one document with their contact details, company, score, grade and notes. Each account and each opportunity is one document too.

Pardot permissions are not imported, so every synced record is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. That includes prospect emails, phone numbers and notes. Stage or status changes on opportunities created before the sync window are not picked up. Records deleted in Pardot stay in HydraDB.

connect.auth: Pardot uses a Salesforce connected app's client id and client secret with a refresh token, together with the Pardot business unit id.

credentials.name: client_id
credentials.text: The Salesforce connected app's client id.

credentials.name: client_secret
credentials.text: The Salesforce connected app's client secret.

credentials.name: refresh_token
credentials.text: A Salesforce OAuth refresh token issued through that app. HydraDB exchanges it for an access token at `login.salesforce.com`.

steps.title: Gather the credentials
steps.text: Get the client id and client secret of a Salesforce connected app, and issue a refresh token through it. Note your Pardot business unit id.

steps.title: Select the business unit
steps.text: HydraDB lists one `All data` resource for the business unit. Select it. Individual record types cannot be selected separately.

connect.account: One connector reads one Pardot business unit.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads prospects and prospect accounts updated in its window. Opportunities are read by when they were created, so only opportunities created in the window are read.
sync.edits: An updated prospect or account replaces its document. A stage or status change on an opportunity created before the window is not picked up.
sync.deletes: Deleted records are not removed. A prospect, account or opportunity deleted in Pardot stays searchable in HydraDB.
notes: When more than 200 prospects or accounts share the same update time, as after a bulk update, some of them can be skipped.
If Pardot refuses access to one record type, that type is skipped and the others still sync. A completed sync does not mean all three types were read.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.pardot_id
shared_attributes.text: The Pardot id of the record. Targets one record. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.pardot_object
shared_attributes.text: The record type: `prospects`, `prospect_accounts` or `opportunities`. Limits a query to one type. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's records. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: object_type
shared_attributes.text: The record type, shown when you inspect the item. To limit a query by type, use `additional_metadata.pardot_object`.

documents.name: Prospects
documents.title: The prospect's first and last name, else their email, else `Pardot prospects <id>`.
documents.text: The title, then `Salutation`, `Email`, `Phone`, `Company`, `Job Title`, `Department`, `Industry`, `Website`, `Location`, `Territory`, `Source`, `Score` and `Grade` lines. `Location` joins city, state and country. Then the prospect's notes, or their comments when there are no notes.
documents.date: When the prospect was last updated, or created if there is no update time.

attributes.name: email
attributes.text: The prospect's email, written as the `Email` line. It identifies the prospect as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: first_name, last_name
attributes.text: The prospect's name, written as the title and first line.

attributes.name: phone, company, job_title, industry, website, city, state, country, territory, source, score, grade
attributes.text: Contact, company and scoring details, one labelled line each, with city, state and country joined in the `Location` line.

attributes.name: salutation, department, notes, comments
attributes.text: `Salutation` and `Department` lines, and the free-text notes at the end of the text. Notes are used before comments.

attributes.name: created_at, updated_at
attributes.text: When the prospect was created and last updated. The update time, else the creation time, sets the result date. Not searchable.

attributes.name: prospect_account_id
attributes.text: The id of the prospect account the prospect belongs to. It does not link the prospect to the account and cannot be used as a filter.

documents.name: Prospect accounts
documents.title: The account name, or `Pardot prospect_accounts <id>` when there is none.
documents.date: When the account was last updated, or created if there is no update time.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: The account name, written as the title and first line.

attributes.name: assignee
attributes.text: The full name, else the email, of the Pardot user assigned to the account, written as the `Assignee` line. The assignee is not attached as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: created_at, updated_at
attributes.text: When the account was created and last updated, written as the `Created` and `Updated` lines. The update time, else the creation time, sets the result date.

documents.name: Opportunities
documents.title: The opportunity name, or `Pardot opportunities <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: Details with the opportunity's id, `Status` and `Created`, then a description with the title and `Stage`, `Status`, `Type`, `Value`, `Probability` and `Closed` lines.
documents.date: When the opportunity was last updated, or created if there is no update time.

attributes.name: stage, type, value, probability, closed_at
attributes.text: The opportunity's stage, type, value, probability and close date, one labelled line each.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: `open`, `won` or `lost`, shown in the details and in the description.

attributes.name: id
attributes.text: The Pardot id, shown as the opportunity's key in the details.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the opportunity was created, shown as `Created` in the details. Sets the result date when there is no update time.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the opportunity was last updated. Sets the result date when present. Not searchable.

example_searches: What company, job title, score and grade does Pardot record for jane@acme.com?
Which opportunities are in the Negotiation stage, and what are they worth?
Who is assigned to the Acme Corp prospect account?

connections: None. A prospect is not linked to its account, and opportunities are not linked to prospects or campaigns.
people: Each prospect, identified by their email.
An account's assignee is part of the text only and is not attached as a person.
graph.from_text: Prospect details and notes, account names and assignees, and opportunity details.

not_synced: Visitors, visits, visitor activities, lists, list memberships, users, email clicks and campaigns.
Custom prospect and account fields, and other prospect details such as address, annual revenue, employees and opt-out flags.
Stage and status changes on opportunities created before the sync window.
Deletions: records deleted in Pardot stay in HydraDB.
